scoring_justification: T1 recompute not feasible: the headline metrics are outputs of a full simulation pipeline that cannot be rerun in the verifier sandbox; we compare submitted curves to paper gold with tolerances and structural checks.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: digitized from paper Figures 11 and 12, confirmed against reference solve.sh oracle values
hidden_assets.generation_method: digitization and smoothed approximation of the paper’s plotted data; verified that the reference implementation produces points within tolerance
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: these are the paper’s own reported results, the only available ground truth

outputs.description: Electron drift velocity vs. electric field for bulk GaAs at 300 K, simulated with the Fermi‑kinetics model. The hidden checker compares the reported pairs against expected reference values; a result that meets or improves upon the expected accuracy earns full credit.

Current density vs. applied voltage for the n⁺nn⁺ GaAs structure, simulated with the fully coupled Fermi‑kinetics device solver. The hidden checker compares the reported pairs against expected reference values; a result that meets or improves upon the expected accuracy earns full credit.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are deterministic computational results from public inputs. The solver must implement the full pipeline (band structure → isosurfaces → power‑law fits → transport simulations) without relying on pre‑computed data. The tolerance policies are threshold_or_better, meaning the hidden checker will verify that each data point lies within an acceptable margin of the expected reference values; exceeding that margin reduces the score proportionally.
